scenarios.title: Return a faulty product
goals: Say what you bought and what went wrong
Explain the problem
Show that you have your receipt
Ask for your money back

ai.zh: 你好，请问我可以帮你做什么？
ai.en: Hello, what can I do to help you?

ai.zh: 真对不起。具体是什么问题？
ai.en: Very sorry about that. What exactly is the problem?

ai.zh: 好的。你还留着买东西时的小票吗？
ai.en: Okay. Have you kept the receipt from when you bought it?

ai.zh: 我们可以给你换一个新的，也可以把钱退给你。你想怎么办？
ai.en: We can give you a new one, or we can give you your money back. What would you like?

ai.zh: 好的，请你在这里签一下名，钱很快就会退给你。
ai.en: Okay, please sign here, and the money will be returned to you soon.

you.zh: 你好，我上周在这里买了一部手机，可是它坏了。
you.en: Hello, I bought a phone here last week, but it is broken.

you.zh: 它昨天突然不能开机了，我什么办法都试过了。
you.en: It suddenly could not be turned on yesterday, and I have tried every method.

you.zh: 我留着，小票在这里。
you.en: I have, and the receipt is here.

you.zh: 我想退货，因为这部手机的质量不太好。
you.en: I want to return it, because the quality of this phone is not very good.

scenarios.title: See a doctor
goals: Say what is wrong
Say how long it has lasted and about the fever
Answer about allergies and ask about an injection
Ask what you should do to get better

ai.zh: 你好，请坐。你哪里不舒服？
ai.en: Hello, please sit down. Where do you feel unwell?

ai.zh: 咳嗽几天了？有没有发烧？
ai.en: How many days have you been coughing? Have you had a fever?

ai.zh: 我先给你检查一下。不太严重，可能是感冒了。你对药过敏吗？
ai.en: Let me examine you first. It is not very serious; it may be a cold. Are you allergic to any medicine?

ai.zh: 不用打针，我给你开三天的药，每天吃三次。
ai.en: You do not need an injection. I will give you three days of medicine, to be taken three times a day.

ai.zh: 要多休息，多喝水。三天以后再来检查一下。
ai.en: You must rest more and drink more water. Come back for a check in three days.

you.zh: 医生，我一直咳嗽，晚上睡不好。
you.en: Doctor, I keep coughing, and I do not sleep well at night.

you.zh: 已经三天了，我昨天晚上有点发烧。
you.en: It has been three days, and last night I had a bit of a fever.

you.zh: 我对药不过敏。需要打针吗？
you.en: I am not allergic to medicine. Do I need an injection?

you.zh: 好的，谢谢医生。我回家以后应该注意什么？
you.en: Okay, thank you, doctor. What should I pay attention to when I get home?

scenarios.title: Open a bank account
goals: Say you want to open an account
Ask how to fill in the form
Say you have chosen a password
Ask about fees

ai.zh: 你好，请问你要办理什么业务？
ai.en: Hello, what business would you like to do?

ai.zh: 好的。请把你的身份证给我，再填一下这张表格。
ai.en: Okay. Please give me your ID card and fill in this form.

ai.zh: 这里写名字和电话。写好以后，请你想一个六位数的密码。
ai.en: Write your name and phone number here. After that, please think of a six-digit password.

ai.zh: 可以，手续已经办好了。你的银行卡三天以后就能拿到。
ai.en: Yes. The procedure has already been done. You can get your bank card in three days.

ai.zh: 不用，存款超过一百块就不收费。
ai.en: No. If your deposit is over a hundred yuan, there is no charge.

you.zh: 你好，我想开一个新的银行账户。
you.en: Hello, I want to open a new bank account.

you.zh: 好的。这张表格我应该怎么填？
you.en: Okay. How should I fill in this form?

you.zh: 好了，我想好密码了。现在可以输入吗？
you.en: Done, I have thought of a password. Can I enter it now?

you.zh: 请问，我每个月要付手续费吗？
you.en: Excuse me, do I have to pay a service charge every month?

scenarios.title: Share an idea at a meeting
goals: Offer your idea
Explain how it would work
Answer the worry about money
Support the decision and suggest a schedule

ai.zh: 大家好，今天我们来讨论一下新产品的宣传方案。谁先说？
ai.en: Hello, everyone. Today we will discuss the publicity plan for the new product. Who will speak first?

ai.zh: 这个想法不错。你有具体的方案吗？
ai.en: That is a good idea. Do you have a concrete plan?

ai.zh: 不过这样会花很多钱。你有没有考虑过成本？
ai.en: But this will cost a lot of money. Have you thought about the cost?

ai.zh: 好，我同意先试一下。其他人还有什么意见？
ai.en: Good, I agree to try it first. What other opinions does anyone have?

ai.zh: 好，那就这样决定。谢谢大家。
ai.en: Good, let us decide it that way. Thank you, everyone.

you.zh: 我先说。我觉得我们可以在网上做宣传，因为现在很多人都在网上买东西。
you.en: I will go first. I think we can advertise online, because many people shop online now.

you.zh: 有。我们可以请一些有名的人介绍产品，这样更容易吸引顾客。
you.en: Yes. We can ask some famous people to introduce the product, which makes it easier to attract customers.

you.zh: 我考虑过了。我们可以先少做一点，如果效果好，再多做一些。
you.en: I have. We can do a little first, and if the results are good, do more.

you.zh: 我也同意。不过我们要定一个时间表，这样才能按时完成。
you.en: I agree too. But we need to set a schedule, so that we can finish on time.

scenarios.title: Report a problem in your flat
goals: Say what is broken
Say how long it has been broken
Agree on a time to come
Ask for a phone call

ai.zh: 你好，这里是物业，请问有什么事？
ai.en: Hello, this is the property office. What is the matter?

ai.zh: 好的。请问是什么时候开始坏的？
ai.en: Okay. When did it start to go wrong?

ai.zh: 真不好意思。我们马上安排师傅去看一下。你什么时候在家？
ai.en: I am really sorry. We will arrange for a repairman to take a look right away. When are you at home?

ai.zh: 好的，师傅四点左右到。如果要换新的，可能需要你付一点钱，可以吗？
ai.en: Okay, the repairman will arrive at about four. If a new part is needed, you may have to pay a little. Is that all right?

ai.zh: 会的，他到楼下的时候会给你打电话。
ai.en: Yes, he will call you when he gets downstairs.

you.zh: 你好，我住在三号楼。我家的空调坏了，一点也不冷。
you.en: Hello, I live in building three. The air conditioner at my home is broken and does not cool at all.

you.zh: 昨天晚上就不行了，现在家里热得我睡不好。
you.en: It stopped working last night, and now it is so hot at home that I cannot sleep well.

you.zh: 我下午三点以后都在家，请师傅那个时候来吧。
you.en: I am at home after three in the afternoon, so please ask the repairman to come then.

you.zh: 可以。请问师傅来之前，会先给我打电话吗？
you.en: That is fine. Will the repairman call me first, before coming?

scenarios.title: Ask a tour guide
goals: Ask about the route for the day
Ask about tickets
Ask where and when to meet
Ask what to do if you get lost

ai.zh: 大家好，我是你们的导游。今天我们会去三个景点，请大家跟着我。
ai.en: Hello, everyone. I am your tour guide. Today we will visit three sights, so please follow me.

ai.zh: 上午我们参观古城，中午吃饭，下午爬山。
ai.en: In the morning we visit the old town, at noon we eat, and in the afternoon we climb the mountain.

ai.zh: 古城的门票包括在内，山上的要自己买，一个人五十块。
ai.en: The ticket for the old town is included, but you must buy the one for the mountain yourselves, fifty yuan each.

ai.zh: 下午两点，我们在山下的停车场集合。请大家一定要准时。
ai.en: At two in the afternoon, we meet at the car park at the foot of the mountain. Everyone must be on time, please.

ai.zh: 请记下我的电话。有问题就给我打电话，我会马上去找你。
ai.en: Please note down my phone number. If there is a problem, call me and I will come and find you at once.

you.zh: 导游，请问今天的路线是怎么样的？
you.en: Guide, excuse me, what is today's route like?

you.zh: 旅行费用包括门票吗？
you.en: Does the cost of the trip include the tickets?

you.zh: 好的。下午我们几点在哪里集合？
you.en: Okay. At what time and where do we meet in the afternoon?

you.zh: 如果我不小心迷路了，应该怎么联系你？
you.en: If I get lost by accident, how should I contact you?

scenarios.title: Sign up as a volunteer
goals: Say you want to volunteer
Say which activity you like and why
Say when you are free
Ask what you need to bring

ai.zh: 你好，欢迎来到社区服务中心。请问你有什么事？
ai.en: Hello, welcome to the community service centre. What brings you here?

ai.zh: 太好了！你对哪种活动比较有兴趣？我们有照顾老人、教孩子学习，还有整理大家捐来的旧书。
ai.en: Great! Which kind of activity are you more interested in? We have looking after old people, teaching children, and sorting the old books people have donated.

ai.zh: 那太合适了。你每个星期有多少时间？
ai.en: That is just right. How much time do you have each week?

ai.zh: 可以。这个活动是免费的，你只需要填一下这张报名表。
ai.en: That is fine. The activity is free, and you only need to fill in this sign-up form.

ai.zh: 不用，你自己来就行。下个星期六见！
ai.en: No need, just come yourself. See you next Saturday!

you.zh: 你好，我想报名当志愿者。
you.en: Hello, I would like to sign up as a volunteer.

you.zh: 我对教孩子学习比较有兴趣，因为我会说两种语言。
you.en: I am more interested in teaching children, because I can speak two languages.

you.zh: 我每个星期六上午都有空，可以吗？
you.en: I am free every Saturday morning. Is that all right?

you.zh: 好的。请问我还需要带什么东西？
you.en: Okay. Excuse me, what else do I need to bring?

scenarios.title: Sign a work contract
goals: Ask about the trial period
Ask about insurance
Ask about overtime pay
Say you are ready to sign

ai.zh: 你好，欢迎加入我们公司。这是你的工作合同，请你先看一下。
ai.en: Hello, welcome to our company. This is your work contract, so please take a look at it first.

ai.zh: 试用期是三个月。试用期的工资是正式工资的一半。
ai.en: The trial period is three months. The pay during the trial period is half of the full pay.

ai.zh: 有。公司会给你买保险，你不用自己付钱。
ai.en: Yes. The company will buy insurance for you, and you do not have to pay yourself.

ai.zh: 有时候需要加班，不过加班的话，我们会多付工资。
ai.en: Sometimes you will need to work overtime, but if you do, we will pay you more.

ai.zh: 可以，请在最后一页签上你的名字，再写上今天的日期。
ai.en: You may. Please sign your name on the last page and write today's date.

you.zh: 谢谢。请问，试用期是多长时间？
you.en: Thank you. Excuse me, how long is the trial period?

you.zh: 好的。那公司有保险吗？
you.en: Okay. And does the company provide insurance?

you.zh: 明白了。请问我平时需要加班吗？加班的话，公司会多给钱吗？
you.en: I see. Do I need to work overtime normally? If I do, will the company pay more?

you.zh: 好的，我没有问题了。我现在可以签名吗？
you.en: Okay, I have no more questions. Can I sign now?

phrases.zh: 不好意思，我没听清楚，能请你再说一遍吗？
phrases.en: Sorry, I did not hear clearly. Could you say it once more, please?

phrases.zh: 你的意思是不是说，我们明天再讨论？
phrases.en: Do you mean that we will discuss it again tomorrow?

phrases.zh: 请你说得慢一点，我想记下来。
phrases.en: Please speak a little more slowly; I want to write it down.

phrases.zh: 这个词我不太了解，你能解释一下吗？
phrases.en: I do not quite understand this word. Could you explain it?

phrases.zh: 我觉得你说得很有道理，不过我有不同的看法。
phrases.en: I think what you say makes a lot of sense, but I see it differently.

phrases.zh: 我先说一下我的想法，请大家提意见。
phrases.en: Let me say my thoughts first, and please give your opinions, everyone.

phrases.zh: 如果有时间的话，我们可以再讨论一下细节。
phrases.en: If there is time, we can discuss the details again.

phrases.zh: 谢谢你的耐心，我学到了很多。
phrases.en: Thank you for your patience; I have learned a lot.
